title: Reader v3.1 shared safe content types

placement.description: Only top-level overview/explanation learning_aids may be part of the main paper explanation; never allowed in nested rich documents.

defaultAnnotation.description: Ignored legacy preloaded annotation metadata. New content omits it; Reader 3.4 does not display, count, or attach it to questions.

methodPipelineConfig.description: Complete directed method framework. Grid positions define desktop layout; reading_order controls navigation, never execution. Semantic coverage requires human review.

inputs.description: Concrete input objects, information, assumptions or conditions needed by this stage.

outputs.description: Concrete products or conclusions this stage provides; do not substitute its role.

flow.description: What this directed relationship transfers or supplies.

cause.description: Why the downstream stage needs this information, or why this relationship holds. Dependency is not automatically experimental causation.

reading_order.description: Optional permutation of all node IDs for previous/next reading navigation; does not imply a linear method.
